parameters.name: Cert
parameters.description: The content of a non-SM certificate in PEM format.

parameters.name: EncryptCert
parameters.description: The content of the SM encryption certificate in PEM format. This parameter is invalid if Cert and Key are not empty.

parameters.name: EncryptPrivateKey
parameters.description: The content of the private key of the SM encryption certificate in PEM format. This parameter is invalid if Cert and Key are not empty.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The private key of a non-SM certificate in PEM format.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The custom name of the certificate. The name can be up to 63 characters long and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

> Certificate names must be unique for each user.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: SignCert
parameters.description: The content of the SM signing certificate in PEM format. This parameter is invalid if Cert and Key are not empty.

parameters.name: SignPrivateKey
parameters.description: The content of the private key of the SM signing certificate in PEM format. This parameter is invalid if Cert and Key are not empty.
